system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

As a Sarutobi, you have inherited the Will of Fire from your forefathers. You embody it more than most other clans in your given village. You’ve been taught that focus and determination is what makes a shinobi strong. This Will is pooled within you, available to be called upon at a moment’s notice. Starting from character creation, you have a number of Will equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus.

You can spend Will on Legacy Techniques and other features that call for it. You regain spent Will when you complete a rest. You gain 2 Legacy Technique at character creation, and an additional one at 7th and 15th levels.

Kindled Will

By spending 1 Will you gain a rank of Mastery to your next d20 based roll. Beginning at 7th level, if you spend 3 Will, you can instead gain two ranks of Mastery. Beginning at 15th level, if you spend 5 Will you gain three ranks of Mastery.

Swift Reaction

Once per turn, by spending 3 Will you gain an additional reaction, which you lose at the end of the current turn if not used. For every additional use beyond the first, increase the Will cost by +1, until you complete a short rest. You cannot have more than one additional reaction per round as a result of this technique.

Aggressive Response

Once per turn, by spending 2 Will you can spend your reaction to cast a jutsu or use a feature with a cost of 1 Action.

Determination

At the beginning of your turn where you need to make a Death saving throw. Before rolling, you can spend 2 Will. When you do, you immediately gain a success before rolling.

Inspiring Will

When an allied creature other than yourself would make a d20 Roll, you can spend 2 Will to grant them a rank of Mastery to their result. Beginning at 7th level, if you spend 4 Will, they can instead gain two ranks of Mastery. Beginning at 15th level, if you spend 6 Will, they gain three ranks of Mastery.

Enduring

When you or an allied creature fail a saving throw, you can spend 2 Will and a reaction to remake the saving throw.

Limit Break

As part of casting a jutsu you know with a casting time of 1 Action, you can spend 3 Will to cast the jutsu again, targeting a different creature as part of the same action at no additional chakra cost.

Second Wind

As a bonus action, you dig deep pulling out a reserve of energy and stamina from your ancestors. Spend any number of Will up to your remaining. For the first Will spent, you roll a die the same size as either your Hit or chakra die. You regain hit or chakra points based on the die rolled equal to the result + your constitution modifier. For every Will spent after the first, roll 1d6, adding it to the result. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until 10 minutes have passed. You cannot use this feature unless you are in combat.
